newsitem.title: POLAND: Mostostal-Z offers foreigners new shares.
newsitem.headline: Mostostal-Z offers foreigners new shares.

text.p: Polish construction company Mostostal Zabrze SA wants to offer two million shares of its new 2.6-million-share issue to foreign investors, deputy president of the company said.

Ryszard Deren told Reuters the Creditanstalt Securities brokerage, offering the shares, would try to place abroad the whole large investor tranche in which investors can subscribe for a minimum of 20,005 shares each.
"Creditanstalt will direct the promotion and subscription in the large investors tranche at foreign investors," he said.
He added, however, that if Polish investors apply they could also buy the shares.
The shares, priced between 9.5 and 12 zlotys, will be offered from November 12 to 13 in the large investor tranche and from November 12 to November 15 in the 0.6-million-share small-investor tranche.
